notes.title: Linux Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is a minor housekeeping update for Linux - the Windows and macOS versions were untouched in this update.

The short version: Valve failed this game for Steam Deck cert because of the Skulls Anywhere login dialog; the service was shut down some time ago so this was no longer supported anyway. I went in and removed the login button and the Skulls Anywhere option in the multiplayer menu, no other changes were made. The game actually works great on Steam Deck as-is!

(For preservation folks: If you want a build with the login button intact, the linux32 branch still has it just in case!)

One known issue that remains from the last version is that Xwayland combined with a high-DPI mode will result in a black screen - for whatever reason multisampling is forced on in Xwayland, which breaks our presentation system (and many others, I would imagine). Thankfully with the SDL2 update you can set SDL_VIDEODRIVER=wayland and get around this with a fully native Wayland window. This will eventually be made the default in a future SDL release, so at some point this will just passively go away. (Also: You can enable specialized high-DPI support by passing /enablehighdpi:1 as a launch argument.)

Thank you for your continued support!

tags.bug: - I went in and removed the login button and the Skulls Anywhere option in the multiplayer menu, no other changes were made.

notes.title: THE FORGOTTEN ISLES! Skulls Beta Update July 23rd
notes.content:
I'm pleased to announced that the Forgotten Isles have been unlocked!  The entire single player campaign is now open.  Huzzah!

These 4 new levels feature a new story line, as well as the Tanuki monk and gameplay progression - meaning you'll build up your forces as you go and take them with you to the next level.  The forgotten Isles are a weird, dangerous place!

Also, we've added a notification tray to help you multitask but still keep on top of your Skulls games.  Notifications appear in two cases:
- when it's your turn in a Skulls Anywhere match
- when you've searched for an online match and found a game in the background (to use background searches, anytime you fail to find a game, click "keep searching" to search in the background)

Tray notifications only appear if Skulls is minimized or not the active application.  So if you're waiting for your turn or other online players, just minimize Skulls and click on the notification when it pops up.

Full details on the update below.  Enjoy!

-------------------------------------------------------------
beta 1.009 - 7/23/13 - changelist 7604
-------------------------------------------------------------
Unlock the Forgotten Isles (4 levels), with developer commentary.
Add Notification Tray which will popup if the game is minimized and the player receives a turn notification, or when an online background search is successful
Fix join sometimes failing when joining an online match via background search while in the campaign (or a local multiplayer match)
Add back option to steam leaderboard choice dlg
Fix random crash in ricepaddyoutliner b/c of paddy w/no layer yet
Fix mp2fall_4 potion setup
Tune all multiplayer Forgotten Isles maps
Clarify some dialog messages that were displaying “sign in” when actually offline or disconnected 
Make sure achievements won outside of end-of level are awarded immediately (like emblem crafting related achievements).
award progress achievements for completing each world on normal after any level, in case the player goes back to an earlier level on normal difficulty

notes.title: Fall is here!? Skulls Beta Update July 17th
notes.content:
Big change to your summer: fall is here!  In Skulls of the Shogun, anyway. :)  Please enjoy the Land of Golden Harvest, but harden your skills... for soon, winter is coming.

Lots of little fixes also included in the update, including a big fix to make the leaderboards more worthwhile - per-difficulty leaderboards!  Previously you could play on casual difficulty and your score would get included right alongside the regular normal difficulty, which meant you could get some suspiciously good scores. :)  These are tracked independently now.  Full fix details below.

-------------------------------------------------------------
beta 1.007 - 7/17/13 - changelist 7550
-------------------------------------------------------------
Unlock Land of Golden Harvest (4 levels), with developer commentary.
Track level clear times separately for casual & normal difficulties, and upload to level specific leaderboards accordingly.  Overall campaign clear time reflects proper time based on selected difficulty.
Fix for cloud load of campaign options when auto-signing in
Fix for loading save game in post-collection mode area (like beach 2.3) resetting unit move left.
Remove line of code from attack action from unused code that could *maybe* (albeit not v likely) cause projectile to attack to not complete...
Better detection of whether Steam is running and logging of steam errors
Fix crash that could occur with host existing online match, and when restarting a new match
Prevent crash while showing emblems. Make sure unequip emblem does not show as "locked" and is full color
Transfer cleansing shrine damage targets in Skulls Anywhere to ensure 100% sync and prevent related issues
Fix input handling bug when dialog transitions screen re-triggering dialog (like when using load Game from campaign menu).
Award XP for finishing a season, getting gold skulls, killing Yuki and the Shogun of the Dead

Fix bad color tag in Russian Profile Screen Die Again help text
Fix script issue in Bedlam Beach section 2 when loading autosave, could leave dialog on screen.
Team Deathmatch - Display team name under player name in turn start if team mode, Display ??? for team names in Player info dialog on 1st round of Skulls Anywhere game (before teams are set).
Fix teams getting reset in Skulls Anywhere when restarting turn.
Change singleplayer locked warning text - change “multiplayer beta" to "beta” to reduce confusion

notes.title: Beta Update - June 29th
notes.content:
Hey all, another update with the latest fixes. Thanks again for all the help finding issues and playtesting!

Borut

---
* Fix loading save games in Skulls Online matches (pick from map selection list when creating game).
* Skulls online: private slots work in player matches. Set these if you'd like to reserve spaces for invited players (other players won't join these slots for matchmaking purposes).
* Fix entering army select with background on top of armies and UI 
* Fix for preventing joining a network session via invite with max players reached thru guest players
* Fix crash in chat window when clicking on chat log and then back on text input
* 4P Ashful Abyss map tuning
* 4P Lion's Gauntlet position tuning to balance archer positions amongst teams
* 3P Ashful Abyss tuning (protect one summon shrine from collision like others, skoot one slightly more in the middle between top 2 players).
* Skulls Online - handle notifying other players faster when someone manually disconnects (instead of waiting for timeout)
* Fix leaderboard scrolling/page up/down
* Fix for selecting diff unit while awakening general (leaving general still technically activated)
* Don't timeout chat button display with mouse timeout if there are unseen messages.
* Skulls Anywhere email notifications sent in language of receiving user.
* Fix for resolution options not getting saved first time always.
* Scale film grain for 25:9 (or other variable resolutions)
* Fix a couple swapped Steam achievements
* Up Speed of Shogun achievement time to 4 hours, clarify text for Tanuki taunt achievement
* Fix mouse highlight over target while unit is moving showing up over consumed skulls.
* Play game lose anim, not game win anim when exiting network game if already dead, and don't leave pause up so animation plays normally.

notes.title: Beta Update - June 26th
notes.content:
Hey everybody - Thanks again for all the help with beta feedback!

Here's the changes for the latest update, mostly minor fixes but a couple fixes for bigger but rarer issues.

Thanks again!
  Borut

-------------------------------------------------------------
beta 1.0023 - 6/26/13 - changelist 7438
-------------------------------------------------------------
* Increase net connection timeout to keep very slow, but working, connections from disconnecting
* Fix possible issue with Skulls Anywhere turn order getting mixed up, causing game to fail to load.
* Don't add net disconnect dialogs while playing transition animation out of level (could cause player getting stuck not being able to see net disconnect dialog)
* Fixes invite not working when player is already in lobby/army select screen.
* Fixed problem where Skulls Anywhere email notifications were checking the option on the sending player, not the receiver.
* If email notifications option was changed offline, upload to server when merging w/cloud stats
* User smaller font on player name on Winner screen if > 18 characterss
* Fix for entering joining a Skulls Anywhere game ,entering army select, and generals would not appear.
* Fix not being able to use Ok screen button with mouse in main menu Settings in lower resolutions.
* Fix for radius actor not updating in Skulls Online when fullscreen but alt-tabbed away
* Make Skulls Online chat dialog stay up after hitting send (must cancel explicitly using the screen button, escape key, or right mouse button), and don't reset lobby chat log when entering level.
* Make swear filter less aggressive (Hello should be ok :)
* Fix issue with not being able to enter @ on internation keyboards when developer console key (`) conflicts with it.
* Player leaving Skulls Online game after dying will go to lose screen (and get XP properly).
* Remove old demo video (was left from trial Xbox version, saves on download space)
* Don't detect controller unless it's actually used (button pressed or thumbstick moved), so controller button hints don't show up if controller is only plugged in but not used.

notes.title: Beta update - June 23rd
notes.content:
Hi all - First off would just like to thank you all for playing and giving great feedback! It's been very rewarding to directly discuss features and issues with you. 

I've just updated the beta - we added new features like chat in online games, and optional email notifications for Skulls Anywhere. These should be delivered to you shortly if you don't already have them, details on most important features and fixes below.

(the reason that you see two updates is that a few days ago we pushed another update but didn't post about it - so this is noteworthy stuff since we launched on 6/18) 

We will continue to post as we update the beta.

Happy skull eating!
Ben

[b]beta 1.002 - 6/23/13 - changelist 7420[/b]
[list]
[*]Add chat log for skulls online lobby & gameplay
[*]Skulls anywhere email notifications with user setting
[*]Customizable keys for WASD movement, add support for missing Tab key to be used in customization
[*]Fix player match ending + return to a broken lobby, can now start another match easily
[*]Fix hangs that could occur on the title screen menus
[*]Fix settings list box pos in 2560x1080
[/list]

[b]beta 1.001 - 6/20/13 - changelist 7396[/b]
[list]
[*]Graphics resolution settings available based on user's supported display modes
[*]Localization: Better for international keyboard support for textbox entry (for example Skulls Anywhere user email w/@ symbol).
[*]Localization: Allow manual override for display langauge in Help & Options->Settings
[*]Update title screen coloration & add BONE-A-FIDE!
[*]Progression: “First Win of the Day” stat at the end of a game now properly only awards if the player wins.
[*]Progression: “Winner” stat at the end of a game now properly only awards if the player wins.
[*]Show save icon for min 3 seconds so it is a more visible reminder that autosave happens
[*]Slightly reduced difficulty of Beach 3 and 4
[*]MP map tweaks including minor collision fixes
[*]Fix occaisional bug with tanuki teleport in online games
[*]Fix a couple rare softlocks that could occur between gameplay & cutscenes
[/list]
